<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->

<!--
  A dialog with a walkthrough video: a title and a close button, the player area with a play button and,
  optionally, a list of chapters. Opening the dialog and playing the video are port contracts. Axes: size
  (default, wide), outline (none, chapters: a list under the player), tone.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Chapter } from "./video-modal.types";

  export type VideoModalProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    text: string;
    close: string;
    play: string;
    chaptersTitle: string;
    chapters: Chapter[];
    size?: "default" | "wide";
    outline?: "none" | "chapters";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import Button from "../primitives/button/button.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import List from "../primitives/list/list.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../primitives/list/list-item.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import Title from "../primitives/title/title.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { cn } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    text,
    close,
    play,
    chaptersTitle,
    chapters,
    size = "default",
    outline = "none",
    tone = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: VideoModalProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} tone={tone} landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}>
  <Stack
    gap="4"
    align="stretch"
    class={cn(
      "mx-auto w-full",
      (((size as string) === "wide") ? "max-w-4xl" : "max-w-2xl"),
      "rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-4 shadow-lg"
    )}
    role="dialog"
    aria-label={title}
    data-testid="video-modal"
  >
    <Group gap="2" align="center" justify="between">
      <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
        {text}
      </Text>
      <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" type="button" class="shrink-0" aria-label={close} data-testid="modal-close">
        <LucideIcon name="x" size={16} />
      </Button>
    </Group>
    <Box class="relative" data-testid="player">
      <MediaFrame alt={title} />
      <Button
        variant="default"
        size="default"
        type="button"
        class="absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 rounded"
        aria-label={play}
        data-testid="play"
      >
        <LucideIcon name="play" size={24} />
      </Button>
    </Box>
    {#if ((outline as string) === "chapters")}
      <Stack gap="2" data-testid="chapters">
        <Title as={3} size="base" weight="bold">
          {chaptersTitle}
        </Title>
        <List class="m-0 flex list-none flex-col gap-2 p-0">
          {#each chapters as c (c.id)}
            <ListItem class="flex items-baseline gap-4" data-testid="item">
              <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
                {c.title}
              </Text>
              <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
                {c.text}
              </Text>
            </ListItem>
          {/each}
        </List>
      </Stack>
    {/if}
  </Stack>
</SectionFrame>
